name: Buzz.ai
summary: AI-powered outbound platform: prompt it and it finds intent-ready buyers, writes multichannel sequences and books the meetings. Per-seat plans with monthly credit allowances and a free start.
best_for: GTM teams that want AI to run outbound end-to-end: prompt-driven prospecting of intent-ready buyers, multichannel sequences and meeting booking without adding SDR headcount
skip_if: you send low-volume, hand-crafted outreach (per-seat-plus-credits is overkill), or you're not ready to QA an AI that writes to your market on your behalf
honest_knock: Two meters run at once: seats AND credits: the seat price includes a credit allowance (500 a month on Core, 5,000 on AI Employee, read 7 November 2026), and real outbound volume means credit packages on top, so budget past the sticker. Watch the moving numbers too: the page changed three times since August: a $75 teaser, then $79 a seat on Core; $795 with a promised rise to $1,000, then $695, and since November no published AI Employee price at all, with a two-seat minimum, and Enterprise carries a $2,500 setup fee, so decide on the total for the plan you are actually offered, not the sticker. And the honest fundamental for any AI-SDR: it only books meetings as good as your list and offer, so keep a human reviewing what goes out in your name.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per seat a month (500 credits/mo, billed monthly)
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-11-07 on buzz.ai/pricing and buzz.ai/whitelabels/; USD) Teams: Core is $79 per seat a month with 500 credits a month, billed monthly, with a $0 setup fee footnoted 'waived on prepaid annual'. AI Employee no longer shows a price: the card says 'Custom' with a 'Talk to sales' button, and the comparison table lists 5,000 credits a month, a two-seat minimum, custom billing and the same $0 setup fee 'waived on prepaid annual'. Enterprise is custom too: 25,000 credits a month, five seats included and a $2,500 setup fee. An 'Annual, 25% off' toggle sits above the cards; on 30 September the page kept showing the monthly figures when we switched it, so treat the annual price as unpublished until sales confirms it. The white-label page lists Core White Label at $1,000 a month with 20 seats, billed annually; the AI Employee white-label rate of $250 per seat that we read on 5 September was not on the page on 7 November. The Core card's button says 'Start for free', but the page names no free plan, no free allowance and no end date, so treat it as a way to sign up, not as a free tier. History: in August 2026 the page said Core $125 (launch offer $75 for three months) and AI Employee $795 with a warning it would move to $1,000; from 1 September to at least 30 September it read Core $79 and AI Employee $695 a seat; on 7 November AI Employee was priced on request, which Buzz.ai's Tristan Lefler had also told us by mail the day before.
